description: This file defines an interface 'NotesRepository' which specifies the contract for note data management and synchronization in a note organizing application. It includes methods for observing notes, creating, updating, deleting notes, and managing synchronization status.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting lists of notes based on a query.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a single note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the specified title and content, returning its ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by ID.

methods.name: triggerManualSync
methods.description: Initiates a manual synchronization, typically triggered by UI.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns a StateFlow tracking current synchronization status for UI updates.
